note: Redo pass after art review 2 (2026-10-30): the art director's free fixes, items 1-13 of the redo list. Raw downloads stay untouched; 'node scripts/art/recolor.ts art/edits/redo/edits.json' rebuilds every PNG here. Coordinates are source pixels. Recipe: art/recipes/redo.json. Review 3 (2026-10-30) added the A1 crate planks, the A13 decor fixes and the A3 floor variants of the Surface, the Shallows, the Crystal Depths and the magma; the terrain variants read the fixed sheets in art/edits/terrain/, so replay terrain-fix.ts --recipe on those recipes first.

edits.name: x_l0_crate_stack
edits.note: Redo 1: the loudest thing on the Surface. The #090a14 outline (137 px, 20% of the sprite) becomes the soft #4d2b32 and the bright #d7b594 plank tops the floor's #c09473, so it sits back like the bush and grass. The one #e7d5b3 sparkle goes with the tops; the four strays from other ramps (#19332d, #819796) join the crate's own browns. Review 3 A1 (op 2): the planks from brass #884b2b to wood #ad7757.

ops.note: Review 3 A1: the 217 px of plank faces from the brass/hazard ramp (#884b2b, 2.50:1 on the #c09473 floor) to the wood #ad7757 STYLE gives decor crates (1.39:1, like the bush and grass), a separate op so the first one keeps its count.
